'''TheJungus Saber Squadron''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TheJungus]]
* '''Published:''' 3 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Control Station|Dagobah-D-executorcontrolstation.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Control Station
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Executor Control Station TheJungus.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Yet another dark side space deck featuring a ridiculous number of cards from Death Star 2 set.

== Strategy ==

The idea of the deck is to get most of the fleet out at a decent pace.  Combat response helps get out starfighters fast, since they all have matching pilots, and DS-181-4 combined with Combat Response gets me the Saber Squadron in a few turns.  Godherdt, Piett, Thrawn, Tarkin, and Vader sit on the capitals and help provide heavy support for the smaller ties.  The laser cannons are in there most because of Fel, (1 force to make X=3 is darn good) and Rendili Stardrive makes the Turbolaser batteries really worth it.

Dengar in Punishing One provides great way to turn numbers against the opponet, and also cancels their immunity to attrition.  molator, death squadron, and the droid are all more ways to pump up my damage and attrition.  Scimitar 2 and jonus are there in case i get in a nasty battle and lost by a crudload, since he takes all the damage and attrition.  Finally, the executor sites and flagship ops makes my fleet way way better, and when it gets out there, good things happen.

Id like to make the Dark Maneuvers and Tallon Rolls be the split cards instead, but I cant find any. id greatly appreciate any help you can offer, especially on ways to counter force drain decks.
